items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: I remember one time Bunk flew up from New Orleans to play a concert for Maltz

ctx.x: it. Anyway, I have some of that in my notes pretty well dated, I think, with letters from Gene Williams and other people about his activities.
I remember one time Bunk flew up from New Orleans to play a concert for Maltz, but I think that was after that. I think that was after he went down. Unless maybe that...
That was... Yeah, that wouldn't be before 1947, hardly, I don't believe.
